//: REPOSITORY TOOLING ONLY. This is a .NET and pnpm repository; nothing here ships in any
container, and no project references it. It exists so the documentation checks have a
pinned version Dependabot tracks, instead of an npx invocation nobody updates.
WHY npm AND NOT pnpm, IN A REPOSITORY WHOSE APPLICATION USES pnpm. web/ is a pnpm
workspace and this file is deliberately NOT a member of it (see pnpm-workspace.yaml,
whose packages list names web/app and web/mcp and nothing above them). A loose
package.json at the root that joined that workspace would put markdownlint and
mermaid-cli into the lint, typecheck and build surface of the application, and would put
the application's lockfile in the path of a documentation change. The two dependency
sets have nothing to do with each other, so they get two lockfiles and two tools.
FRONTEND-BFF.md section 7's rule -- one package manager, ALL apps members of one
workspace -- is about APPS. This is not one.
NOTHING HERE RUNS IN THE APPLICATION'S CI JOBS. .github/workflows/docs.yml is the only
workflow that installs it, and ci.yml never sees it.
name: ab-ovo-docs-tooling
description: Documentation tooling for ab-ovo: markdown lint, link and parity checks, diagram pairing, and the Mermaid renderer the LaTeX editions include.

scripts.lint:docs: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:diagrams && npm run lint:parity
